SELECT id, name, contents, category_id, views, use_id, file_id, updateTime FROM post WHERE 1=1
AND name LIKE CONCAT(#{name}, '%')
AND contents LIKE CONCAT(#{contents}, '%')
AND category_id LIKE CONCAT(#{categoryId}, '%')
ORDER BY createdTime DESC
ORDER BY createdTime ASC
ORDER BY category_id
SELECT p.id, p.name, p.contents, p.category_id, p.views, p.use_id, p.file_id, p.updateTime FROM post p JOIN post_tag pt ON p.id = pt.post_id JOIN tag t ON pt.tag_id = t.id WHERE t.name = #{tagName}
